answers.core: This feature should be core to Godot's Android platform support rather than an add-on, as it is a fundamental component of user interaction on Android devices. Including this natively would provide a seamless experience aligned with Android standards, eliminating the need for developers to implement custom Action Bars. Additionally, this enhancement will support accessibility compliance on Android, improving usability for all users and ensuring consistency in text manipulation behavior.
answers.workaround: A script-based workaround to replicate the native Android Action Bar’s functionality is impractical. While it is possible to add basic text editing options through custom UI nodes, this approach lacks the native integration, fluidity, and accessibility provided by the Android Action Bar. Mimicking the exact look, feel, and behavior of Android's text handling would be difficult and would introduce significant complexity without the benefits of a true native experience.

title: Add support for text selection action bars on Android
